title: cryjax: the CRY 1.7 cosmic-ray shower model on JAX devices
description: cryjax samples correlated cosmic-ray showers from the CRY 1.7 tables on JAX devices (CPU or GPU, float32 or float64), and binds the C++ CRY reference through a small C ABI for device-vs-native comparisons. Release tables are external inputs admitted by SHA-256; the CRY licence and notice travel with the package.
references: Hagmann, C., Lange, D., Wright, D., "Cosmic-ray shower generator (CRY) for Monte Carlo transport codes", 2007 IEEE Nuclear Science Symposium Conference Record, doi:10.1109/NSSMIC.2007.4437209
notes: The CRY 1.7 licence (BSD-3-Clause) and its notice travel with the package; see NOTICE.
